words.definition: adj. belonging to a period other than that being portrayed
adj. lasting for a very short time
adj. (of a person) fond of company; sociable
adj. acting or done quickly and without thought or care
adj. (of an action, idea, or goal) deserving praise and commendation
v. to make less severe, serious, or painful
adj. obedient or attentive to an excessive or servile degree
adj. lacking inspiration or excitement; dull
words.translation: 平庸的；乏味的；缺乏新意的

words.definition: adj. dealing with things sensibly and realistically in a way that is based on practical rather than theoretical considerations
adj. accorded a great deal of respect, especially because of age, wisdom, or character
words.translation: 德高望重的；令人尊敬的
